records.question: Summarize all the rules in the fraud memo.
records.answer: The real-time card fraud rules effective March 1, 2026, include R-101 Velocity, which declines the sixth and later card-not-present purchases within 10 minutes and texts the customer [6]. R-104 Geo-jump declines the second card-present purchase and places a soft block if two occur more than 500 miles apart within 2 hours [6]. R-110 First foreign use triggers app step-up verification for a first-ever foreign purchase over $400 [6]. R-117 Merchant risk holds transactions on the high-risk list over $250 for analyst review up to 4 hours [6]. R-122 New-device spend declines purchases over $1,000 within 24 hours of a new device enrolling and requires a call to Customer Care [6]. R-130 ATM pattern blocks ATM access for 24 hours following 3 or more out-of-network ATM withdrawals in one day at different terminals [6].
